result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout issue with duplicated restaurant entries, and a minor styling issue with a partially cut-off card.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side in 'Fastest near you' with the same delivery fee, likely a duplicate data entry
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant results or ensure the list shows distinct restaurants

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Bu...' card is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated without a visible full name or ellipsis context
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional horizontal scrolling, but ensure the truncated name is accessible when tapped or add an ellipsis indicator
